inline_text:
DESIGN.md documents the logo SVGs — but only at lines ~207–212, in the chapter-icons section near the end. The source-of-truth table at the top lists the design system, tokens, and fonts and stops there, so a reader (or agent) who takes the table as the inventory never reaches the brand assets: mine redrew the AAIF mark from a screenshot before I caught it.

This surfaces the three SVGs in the table with per-file purposes (repeating the disambiguation that `aaif-mark.svg` is the full lockup despite its name) and adds a **never redraw the mark** rule next to the other hard-won ones. The existing paragraph at ~207 keeps the derivation details; the table rows are just pointers.

Tested with two context-free agents given "make an event banner, gather the brand assets": on main, the agent found the logos but only by reading DESIGN.md nearly to the end, and flagged that AGENTS.md/README never mention them; on this branch, the table routes it in one hop.
